verdict.rationale: Stripe documents an official MCP server that lets AI agents call the Stripe API and search its docs, plus agent-first developer tooling. A user could therefore drive Stripe through natural language from an external agent client. Nothing shows a built-in natural-language interface for Terminal, or that the MCP tools cover Terminal operations such as reader management or collecting in-person payments. Missing for 10: a native natural-language command interface, documented MCP/agent coverage of Terminal-specific operations, and hands-on or independent corroboration of agent-driven Terminal workflows.
